title: Consolidate GPU scheduler interfaces and provide CUDA 13 / Triton 3 compatibility shims
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
We need to reduce long-term tech debt in our GPU kernel invocation surface by consolidating multiple scheduler/launch interfaces currently dispersed across the codebase (kernel_adapters, runtime/scheduler, and per-backend shims). This ticket implements a single scheduler abstraction with stable ABI shims that let us support CUDA 11/12/13 and Triton 2/3 concurrently and avoids scattered #ifdefs across the kernels.

Goals:
- Introduce SchedulerV2 abstraction with clear upstream/backward-compatible shims.
- Add compatibility layer for CUTLASS ABI changes detected between versions and provide a build-time selector.
- Expand CI build matrix to include CUDA 13 + Triton 3 configurations on internal GPU runners.
- Add microbenchmarks to validate latency/throughput regressions and KV-cache behavior.
- Provide rollback path and automated Canary rollout via runtime-2.0.

Acceptance criteria:
- All kernel entrypoints converge on SchedulerV2 or the shim with feature flags.
- CI passes for linux-cuda13-triton3 build in nightly and PR gating for affected packages.
- No regression >5% p50 latency on our 1k request batch microbenchmark (baseline: runtime-1.18).
- PRs with changes merged and runtime-2.0 branch updated with release notes.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff doc created in Confluence (https://confluence.redwoodcorp.com/display/RUNTIME/SchedulerV2+Design). Initial sketch of SchedulerV2 and shim strategy. Asked infra to provision CUDA13 GPU runner.

2026-02-20 - Ravi Patel: PoC for SchedulerV2 sketched in branch feat/schedulerv2. Local tests show kernel launch abstraction works across cuda-11 and cuda-12. Pushed draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4521

2026-02-25 - Design review (Liu, PM): Agreed on minimal public surface for SchedulerV2. Avoid adding new runtime-visible config flags; prefer automatic detection with opt-out. Action: add telemetry tags for canary rollouts.

2026-03-02 - QA (Jordan Kim): First CI run with cuda13 failed due to CUTLASS symbol mismatch (undefined symbol _ZN7cutlass...). Added temporary shim in cutlass_compat.h to resolve mangling differences. Created issue ENG-12860 to upstream proper fix in kernel generation code.

2026-03-04 - Ravi Patel: Updated PR to include cutlass compatibility header and CMake options to select CUTLASS ABI variant. Added unit tests that mock symbol resolution. New PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4579

2026-03-07 - Perf (Maya Singh): Microbenchmark run on cuda13/triton3 runner shows +3.4% p50 token latency on long-context workloads. Investigation points to kernel launch batching heuristics; opened follow-up ENG-12872 to tune batching params.

2026-03-10 - Release lead (Diego Alvarez): Marked this ticket as target for runtime-2.0 alpha canary. Need docs for rollback and update console rollout plan. Added release note draft: docs/releases/runtime-2.0/schedulerv2.md
